remarks: Welcome to Ridge View at Quarry, where luxury meets customization. Situated on a premium ravine-backing lot, this stunning 2,700 sq. ft. home offers upgraded finishes, a triple-car garage and a thoughtfully designed layout. The main floor features an impressive open-to-above, full bedroom and bathroom, and spacious living areas. Upstairs offers 4 bedrooms, including 2 connected by a Jack & Jill bathroom, plus a walk-in laundry room. The primary retreat features 2 walk-in closets and a spa-inspired ensuite with dual sinks, freestanding tub and separate walk-in shower. Best of all, the plans and finishes can be customized to suit your lifestyle and vision. With multiple premium lots and home sizes available in Ridge View at Quarry, this is your opportunity to build a home that’s truly you (id:67522)
